changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AttributeType') BEGIN EXEC sp_rename 'AttributeType', 'AttributeType_Retired'; END
changeSet.rollback:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AttributeType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AttributeType]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(50000,1) NOT NULL, [ParentID] [int] NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [AttributeTypeCategoryID] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [ShowNameInTree] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_AttributeType_ShowNameInTree] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [DisplayFormat] [nvarchar](250) CONSTRAINT [DF_AttributeType_DisplayFormat] DEFAULT ('') NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AttributeType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_AttributeType_AttributeTypeCategory') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AttributeType] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_AttributeType_AttributeTypeCategory] FOREIGN KEY([AttributeTypeCategoryID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[AttributeTypeCategory] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AttributeType] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_AttributeType_AttributeTypeCategory] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_AttributeType_ParentAttributeType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AttributeType] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_AttributeType_ParentAttributeType] FOREIGN KEY([ParentID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[AttributeType] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AttributeType] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_AttributeType_ParentAttributeType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Attribute_ParentID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Attribute_ParentID] ON [dbo].[AttributeType] ( [ParentID] ASC ) END

changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[AttributeType_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[AttributeType] AFTER DELETE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON delete AssetType where Object = 'AttributeType' and ObjectID in (select ID from deleted); END

changeSet.author: bquinlivan
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[AttributeType_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[AttributeType] AFTER INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; insert into AssetType (Name, Description, Class, DisplayFormat, [State], [Hierarchical], [HierarchyMaximumDepth], [Object], [ObjectID], [CreatedOn], [CreatedBy], [UpdatedOn], [UpdatedBy]) select Name, Description, 5, DisplayFormat, 1, 0, 1, 'AttributeType', ID, coalesce(UpdatedOn, getutcdate()), UpdatedBy, coalesce(UpdatedOn, getutcdate()), UpdatedBy from inserted; END

changeSet.author: bquinlivan
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[AttributeType_AfterUpdate] ON [dbo].[AttributeType] AFTER UPDATE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; update T set T.Name = S.Name, T.Description = S.Description, T.DisplayFormat = S.DisplayFormat, T.UpdatedBy = S.UpdatedBy, T.UpdatedOn = S.UpdatedOn from AssetType T inner join inserted S on T.Object = 'AttributeType' and T.ObjectID = S.ID; END
